#1) Setup
##Read in packages and data
```{r 1.a wd and packages}
for (lib in c('tidyverse','janitor','rstatix','ggpubr','vegan','car','purrr')) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(lib, character.only = TRUE))
}
```

```{r 1.b read in data}
median_data_rare <- readRDS("rarefied_16s_asv_table.rds") 
median_data_rare_18 <- readRDS("rarefied_18s_asv_table.rds")
metadata <- read_csv('metadata_IFGvSBC.csv') 
```

#2) 16S Compute Alpha Diversity and Plot
```{r 2.a calculate alpha diversity metrics per sample}
adiv_16s <- data.frame(
            Richness = specnumber(median_data_rare),  #calculate species richness, 'S'
            Shannon = diversity(median_data_rare, index = 'shannon')) %>% #calculate Shannon Index of diversity, 'H'
            mutate(Pielou = Shannon/log(Richness)) %>% #calculate Pielou's evenness, 'J'
            rownames_to_column(var = "Sample") %>%
            left_join(metadata) 

adiv_16s_long <- adiv_16s %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Richness,Shannon,Pielou),
               names_to = "diversity_metric",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(diversity_metric, IFG_SBC) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1    = quantile(value, 0.25),
    Q3    = quantile(value, 0.75),
    IQR   = Q3 - Q1,
    is_outlier = value < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | value > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

adiv_16s_long$diversity_metric = factor(adiv_16s_long$diversity_metric, levels = c("Richness","Shannon","Pielou"))
```

##Box plot + KW test
```{r 2.b plotting and KW tests}
kw_16s_boxplot <- ggplot(data = adiv_16s_long, aes(x = IFG_SBC, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = IFG_SBC), outlier.shape = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkcyan", "goldenrod2")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(alpha = is_outlier), show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.2) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 0.7, "TRUE" = 0.4)) +
  facet_grid(diversity_metric~., scales = "free", switch='y') +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", paired = FALSE,
                     label.x = 0.7, label.y = 0.1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size =10, face = 'bold'),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = 'outside')

#kw_16s_boxplot
```

##get W statistic and rrs
```{r}
kwu.16.S <- wilcox.test(Richness ~ IFG_SBC, data = adiv_16s)
rrs.16.S <- adiv_16s %>%
rstatix::wilcox_effsize(Richness ~ IFG_SBC)

kwu.16.H <- wilcox.test(Shannon ~ IFG_SBC, data = adiv_16s)
rrs.16.H <- adiv_16s %>%
rstatix::wilcox_effsize(Shannon ~ IFG_SBC)

kwu.16.J <- wilcox.test(Pielou ~ IFG_SBC, data = adiv_16s)
rrs.16.J <- adiv_16s %>%
rstatix::wilcox_effsize(Pielou ~ IFG_SBC)
```


#3) 18S Compute Alpha Diversity and Plot
```{r 3.a calculate alpha diversity metrics per sample}

            mutate(Pielou = Shannon/log(Richness)) %>% #calculate Pielou's evenness, 'J'
            rownames_to_column(var = "Sample") %>%
            left_join(metadata) 

adiv_18s_long <- adiv_18s %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Richness,Shannon,Pielou),
               names_to = "diversity_metric",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(diversity_metric, IFG_SBC) %>%

adiv_18s_long$diversity_metric = factor(adiv_18s_long$diversity_metric, levels = c("Richness","Shannon","Pielou"))
```


#6) Combine and Export the figure
```{r 6.a combine the figures}
combo.adiv <- ggarrange(kw_16s_boxplot, kw_18s_boxplot,
                        align  = 'h',
                        ncol   = 2, nrow = 1,
                        labels = 'auto',
                        widths = c(1, 1))

combo.adiv
```


```{r}
#using ggexport here since ggsave wasnt working with the combined faceted graphs. 
ggexport(combo.adiv,
  filename = "ADiv_Main.pdf",
  width = 160 / 25.4, #conversion to mm from in since thats the units ggexport uses
  height = 120 / 25.4
)
```
